No, that is the Japanese version that is already out for release. The Switch version was released in April 2024 in Japan, but it won't be released globally until October 2024. The PS4/5 version won't be released until much later (nearly a year from now).
Generally speaking, a video game console isn't really conducive to a productive workflow. You probably wouldn't want to do your taxes, create a spreadsheet, write a paper, etc on a game console... and developing a whole video game is much more work than that, so a game console isn't really an ideal work environment.
It could be fun to play around with, but if you have any intentions of taking a serious crack at making a game, you'd be much better off working on a PC.
